# SideNav

The left sidebar for the browser version of the app, replacing BottomNav at desktop widths.

`TVTracker.SideNav` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.SideNav />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.SideNav"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Browser layout: left sidebar replacing BottomNav at desktop widths.

## Props (SideNavProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `"home" \| "watchlist" \| "lists" \| "movies" \| "shows" \| "profile"` | Active section. |
| `hrefs` | `Partial<Record<"home" \| "watchlist" \| "lists" \| "movies" \| "shows" \| "profile" \| "settings", string>>` | Links per section id (plus "settings"); items without one render as plain labels. |
| `brand` | `string` | Wordmark next to the logo tile; default "Watchlog". |
| `userName` | `string` |  |
